# Game Idea: Cosmic Courier

In **Cosmic Courier**, the player pilots a small delivery ship across a scrolling starfield. Asteroids and enemy drones drift in from the right. The ship can thrust up/down and fire a limited laser. Collecting cargo pods adds points, but colliding with any obstacle or letting the laser run out ends the game.

**Lose Condition:** Collision with an asteroid or enemy, or exhausting the laser energy.

1: // Simple Cosmic Courier game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   // ----- Game state -----
12:   const player = {
13:     x: 80,
14:     y: canvas.height / 2,
15:     w: 30,
16:     h: 20,
17:     speed: 3,
18:     laser: 100, // energy %
19:     shooting: false,
20:     cooldown: 0,
21:   };
22:   const pods = [];
23:   const asteroids = [];
24:   const drones = [];
25:   let score = 0;
26:   let gameOver = false;
27:   let frame = 0;
28: 
29:   // ----- Input -----
30:   const keys = {};
31:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
32:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
33: 
34:   // ----- Helpers -----
35:   function rand(min, max) {
36:     return Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
37:   }
38:   function rectCircleColl(rect, cx, cy, cr) {
39:     const dx = Math.max(rect.x - cx, 0, cx - (rect.x + rect.w));
40:     const dy = Math.max(rect.y - cy, 0, cy - (rect.y + rect.h));
41:     return dx * dx + dy * dy <= cr * cr;
42:   }
43: 
44:   // ----- Audio -----
45:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
46:   function playTone(freq, duration = 0.1, type = 'sine', volume = 0.2) {
47:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
48:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
49:     osc.type = type;
50:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
51:     gain.gain.value = volume;
52:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
53:     osc.start();
54:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
55:   }
56:   function playLaser() { playTone(800, 0.07, 'square', 0.3); }
57:   function playExplosion() { playTone(200, 0.2, 'triangle', 0.5); }
58:   function playCollect() { playTone(600, 0.05, 'sawtooth', 0.4); }
59:   // simple background hum
60:   function startBgHum() {
61:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
62:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
63:     osc.type = 'sine';
64:     osc.frequency.value = 60;
65:     gain.gain.value = 0.05;
66:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
67:     osc.start();
68:     // keep running
69:     return () => { osc.stop(); };
70:   }
71:   const stopBgHum = startBgHum();
72:   // unlock on first user interaction
73:   window.addEventListener('keydown', () => { if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); }, {once: true});
74: 
75:   // ----- Main loop -----
76:   function update() {
77:     if (gameOver) return;
78:     frame++;
79:     // player movement
80:     if (keys.ArrowUp) player.y -= player.speed;
81:     if (keys.ArrowDown) player.y += player.speed;
82:     player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height - player.h, player.y));
83: 
84:     // shooting
85:     if (keys[' '] && player.laser > 0 && player.cooldown <= 0) {
86:       player.shooting = true;
87:       player.laser -= 0.5; // drain energy per frame while firing
88:       player.cooldown = 10; // frames between shots
89:       playLaser(); // sound effect
90:     } else {
91:       player.shooting = false;
92:     }
93:     if (player.cooldown > 0) player.cooldown--;
94: 
95:     // spawn objects
96:     if (frame % 80 === 0) asteroids.push({x: canvas.width, y: rand(0, canvas.height), r: rand(15, 30), speed: rand(2, 4)});
97:     if (frame % 120 === 0) drones.push({x: canvas.width, y: rand(0, canvas.height), r: 12, speed: 3});
98:     if (frame % 200 === 0) pods.push({x: canvas.width, y: rand(0, canvas.height), w: 15, h: 15, speed: 2});
99: 
100:     // move objects leftward
101:     const moveLeft = arr => arr.forEach(o => (o.x -= o.speed));
102:     moveLeft(asteroids);
103:     moveLeft(drones);
104:     moveLeft(pods);
105: 
106:     // remove off‑screen
107:     const clean = arr => arr.filter(o => o.x + (o.r || o.w) > 0);
108:     asteroids = clean(asteroids);
109:     drones = clean(drones);
110:     pods = clean(pods);
111: 
112:     // collisions with obstacles
113:     const shipRect = {x: player.x, y: player.y, w: player.w, h: player.h};
114:     for (const a of asteroids) if (rectCircleColl(shipRect, a.x, a.y, a.r)) gameOver = true;
115:     for (const d of drones) if (rectCircleColl(shipRect, d.x, d.y, d.r)) gameOver = true;
116: 
117:     // laser hits obstacles with sound
118:     if (player.shooting) {
119:       const laserX = player.x + player.w;
120:       const laserY = player.y + player.h / 2;
121:       asteroids.forEach((a, i) => {
122:         if (Math.abs(a.x - laserX) < 10 && Math.abs(a.y - laserY) < a.r) {
123:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
124:           playExplosion();
125:         }
126:       });
127:       drones.forEach((d, i) => {
128:         if (Math.abs(d.x - laserX) < 10 && Math.abs(d.y - laserY) < d.r) {
129:           drones.splice(i, 1);
130:           playExplosion();
131:         }
132:       });
133:     }
134: 
135:     // collect cargo pods with sound
136:     pods.forEach((p, i) => {
137:       if (
138:         p.x < player.x + player.w &&
139:         p.x + p.w > player.x &&
140:         p.y < player.y + player.h &&
141:         p.y + p.h > player.y
142:       ) {
143:         score += 10;
144:         pods.splice(i, 1);
145:         playCollect();
146:       }
147:     });
148:   }
149: 
150:   function draw() {
151:     // starfield background with gradient and twinkling stars
152:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
153:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001d3d'); // dark blue top
154:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000'); // black bottom
155:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
156:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
157:     // draw stars with varying brightness
158:     for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) {
159:       const sx = rand(0, canvas.width);
160:       const sy = rand(0, canvas.height);
161:       const bright = Math.random() * 255;
162:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${bright},${bright},${bright})`;
163:       ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 1, 1);
164:     }
165:     // player ship (triangle) with gradient
166:     const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(player.x, player.y, player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h);
167:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#00ff80');
168:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#006630');
169:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
170:     ctx.beginPath();
171:     ctx.moveTo(player.x, player.y + player.h / 2);
172:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w, player.y);
173:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h);
174:     ctx.closePath();
175:     ctx.fill();
176:     // ship outline
177:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#0f0';
178:     ctx.lineWidth = 1;
179:     ctx.stroke();
180:     // laser beam
181:     if (player.shooting && player.laser > 0) {
182:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff0';
183:       ctx.lineWidth = 2;
184:       ctx.beginPath();
185:       ctx.moveTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h / 2);
186:       ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, player.y + player.h / 2);
187:       ctx.stroke();
188:     }
189:     // asteroids with radial gradient
190:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
191:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.r);
192:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#bbb');
193:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
194:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
195:       ctx.beginPath();
196:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
197:       ctx.fill();
198:       // subtle outline
199:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#222';
200:       ctx.lineWidth = 1;
201:       ctx.stroke();
202:     });
203:     // enemy drones with radial gradient
204:     drones.forEach(d => {
205:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(d.x, d.y, d.r * 0.3, d.x, d.y, d.r);
206:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff6b6b');
207:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#b30000');
208:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
209:       ctx.beginPath();
210:       ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, d.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
211:       ctx.fill();
212:       // thin outline
213:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#880000';
214:       ctx.lineWidth = 1;
215:       ctx.stroke();
216:     });
217:     // cargo pods (glowing crates) with gradient
218:     pods.forEach(p => {
219:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(p.x, p.y, p.x + p.w, p.y + p.h);
220:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#00ffff');
221:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#0044ff');
222:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
223:       ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h);
224:       // subtle glow outline
225:       ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,255,255,0.6)';
226:       ctx.lineWidth = 2;
227:       ctx.strokeRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h);
228:     });
229:     // HUD
230:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
231:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
232:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
233:     ctx.fillText('Laser: ' + Math.floor(player.laser) + '%', 10, 40);
234:     if (gameOver) {
235:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
236:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
237:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
238:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
239:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
240:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
241:     }
242:   }
243: 
244:   function loop() {
245:     update();
246:     draw();
247:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
248:   }
249: 
250:   // start the game
251:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
252: })();
